items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: You know who he is? Oscar Cohen. Oscar Cohen was a student of mine at one time.

ctx.x: That's not really an answer, "It will come to you."

It will. Now, see, Milt, you must realize that all these things I'm saying is dedicated on the things that happened to me. I can only tell it...give some advice concerning what helped me. Because it was late in life when I found out my talent was in music. I got involved with it and found out I could play different things. See, I had heard so many good musicians, and a talent for music and didn't know it. I went into it and learned about music. But after I learned about it, I found out I could pick up on it…
